quiz.q: Which item must NOT appear on her label yet if she has not completed registration?
quiz.explain: Only print a NAFDAC number once it has been issued. Net weight, batch code and ingredients should always appear.

quiz.q: A run costs 36,500 naira and gives 73 good bars. What is the cost per bar?
quiz.explain: 36,500 / 73 = 500 naira per bar.

quiz.q: Her cost per bar is 583 naira. A buyer asks for 550 naira per bar for 10 cartons. What is the best response?
options: Explain her bulk price ladder and offer the lowest step that stays above cost
Accept and use cheaper caustic soda
Refuse to talk to the buyer
quiz.explain: Selling below cost loses money on every bar. Offer a bulk price that still covers cost and leaves a margin.

quiz.q: What does the batch code BB-2610-02 tell you?
options: Bath bar, October 2026, second batch that month
quiz.explain: In this course's system: BB = bath bar, 2610 = year 2026, month 10, and 02 = the second batch that month.

quiz.q: Equipment cost 120,000 naira and each run makes 15,000 naira profit. How many runs to pay it back?
A customer sends a screenshot of a transfer and asks for her cartons now. What should she do?
options: Check her own bank account or app to confirm the money has arrived first
quiz.explain: Screenshots can be faked. Confirm the payment in your own account or app before releasing goods.

quiz.q: Which buyer is most likely to give steady repeat orders for laundry bars?
options: A friend who visits once a year
quiz.explain: Laundry businesses use soap every day and need reliable bulk supply, so they reorder regularly.

finalQuiz.q: Which pair of choices best fits a laundry bar?
finalQuiz.explain: Laundry bars need strong cleansing (PKO or coconut) and low superfat so oil does not stain clothes.

finalQuiz.q: When mixing a lye solution, what is the correct order?
options: Pour water onto the caustic soda
Add caustic soda slowly to the water
Mix both in an aluminium pot
Add hot water to the flakes quickly
finalQuiz.explain: Always add caustic soda to water, slowly. Pouring water onto caustic soda can boil and splash violently.

finalQuiz.q: A formula has 500 g PKO (SAP 0.176) and 500 g palm oil (SAP 0.142). What is the caustic soda at 2% superfat?
Lye on a worker's arm. What should happen first?
options: Flush with plenty of running water for at least 15 minutes
finalQuiz.explain: Water is the correct first aid for caustic soda on skin. Flush for at least 15 minutes and remove soaked clothing.

finalQuiz.q: In hot process, how does she know the cook is finished?
options: When a cooled sample tests about pH 9 to 10 and shows no oily or wet centre
When it turns pink with phenolphthalein
finalQuiz.explain: Judge by test, not by time. Phenolphthalein turns pink in all soap, so it cannot confirm the cook is finished.

finalQuiz.q: Why must soap be fully dry before grating it for laundry powder?
options: Wet soap makes the powder clump and cake
Dry soap has more caustic soda
Washing soda only works with dry soap
finalQuiz.explain: Moisture causes soap gratings and washing soda to clump. Dry gratings blend into a free-flowing powder.

finalQuiz.q: Ten bars weighed 2,000 g at cutting and 1,860 g after drying. What is the weight loss?
A batch tests pH 12 and stings the hands. What should she do?
options: Sell it cheaply as laundry soap
Label it NOT FOR SALE and set it aside
finalQuiz.explain: Lye-heavy soap must never be sold. Set it aside, recheck the sums and only rework it if the correction can be calculated with confidence.

finalQuiz.q: Which bath formula is most likely to have a cleansing number inside SoapCalc's 12 to 22 range?
options: 20% PKO with palm, olive, shea and castor
finalQuiz.explain: Keeping PKO or coconut to about a fifth of the oils keeps cleansing in range for a bath bar.

finalQuiz.q: Which ingredient must never be added to soap?
finalQuiz.explain: WHO warns mercury in skin-lightening products is dangerous, and the Minamata Convention restricts mercury-added cosmetics.

finalQuiz.q: A run costs 50,000 naira and yields 80 good bars. What is the floor price per bar?
finalQuiz.explain: 50,000 / 80 = 625 naira. Selling below this loses money.

finalQuiz.q: Which growth step should come first?
options: Sell to supermarkets in three states
Make every batch pass its tests
finalQuiz.explain: Consistent quality comes first; then steady buyers, then larger runs and registration for bigger retailers.

capstone.brief: Produce, test and cost one hot-process laundry batch and one bath soap batch, then present them as a sellable product line with labels, a price ladder and a first bulk buyer contact.

Design labels with batch codes for each product.
